evals.prompt: Write a JavaScript function that takes a list of ISRCs and returns only the tracks with BPM between 120 and 140 using the MeloData API
evals.expected_output: A function that calls batch/features, filters by bpm range, handles auth and errors
expectations: Uses POST /v1/tracks/batch/features endpoint
Includes Authorization header with Bearer token
Filters results by bpm >= 120 and bpm <= 140
Handles the case where features may be null (not_found tracks)

evals.prompt: I need a Python script that gets audio features for a song, and if the API returns 202, retries until it gets the data
evals.expected_output: Python function with retry logic for 202 status, using Retry-After header
expectations: Checks for 202 before treating the response as complete
Respects Retry-After with bounded polling and per-request timeouts
Does not recurse indefinitely or retry monthly quota exhaustion immediately
Handles a terminal 200 unavailable response without dereferencing absent features

evals.prompt: Build a music recommendation feature that finds tracks similar to 3 seed songs, preferring high-energy danceable tracks
evals.expected_output: Code using the recommendations endpoint with seed ISRCs and target_energy/target_danceability params
expectations: Uses GET /v1/recommendations endpoint
Passes multiple seed parameters
Sets target_energy and target_danceability query params
Handles the response format with match_score

evals.prompt: I have 200 titles and artists and want audio features. I am on the Free plan. Build an importer that can resume after a network failure.
evals.expected_output: Explains 25 monthly rows, 10 per job and one active job; does not promise to submit 200 on Free. Uses saved jobs and persisted keys.
expectations: Checks bulk allowance before submission; 25 Free rows/month, 10/job, one active job
Uses POST /tracks/jobs and persists submission key plus job ID
Reuses same key and identical ordered inputs after an uncertain request
Reads track.result.features and preserves order, duplicate rows and unsuccessful outcomes

evals.prompt: My bulk job finished with completed, needs_review and failed rows. Can I resubmit the list to try again?
evals.expected_output: Preserves completed work, uses failed-item retry, and requires review for weak matches.
expectations: Uses POST /tracks/jobs/{id}/retry with a persisted retry-cycle key
Retries only failed items, maximum two cycles, without extra allowance
Does not silently analyze needs_review matches
Explains seven-day expiry is not extended by retries

evals.prompt: Resolve this song title and artist, then analyze it. What do I do if resolution returns 503 or a medium-confidence radio edit?
evals.expected_output: Distinguishes temporary dependency failures from no match and asks for recording review.
expectations: Uses encoded GET /tracks/resolve title and artist parameters
Preserves recording qualifiers
503 is transient and uses bounded Retry-After handling, while 404 means no acceptable match
Does not automatically analyze a medium-confidence recording variant

evals.prompt: Can I depend on liveness and valence being available on every track? What does the loudness number mean?
evals.expected_output: Explains nullable fields, archive/live differences and preview measurement limits.
expectations: Liveness is currently null across sources
Live valence, acousticness and instrumentalness are null
Speechiness can be present for live analysis
Loudness is preview-based, not guaranteed full-master loudness; no Spotify-identical promise

evals.prompt: How much quota do errors, a successful 50-track batch, pre-analysis, and a replayed bulk submission consume?
evals.expected_output: Separates implemented direct-request billing from bulk row allowance and flags older documentation discrepancies.
expectations: 202, 4xx and 5xx consume no lookup quota
Successful batch/features currently counts one request, not 50 tracks
Successful batch/analyze currently consumes a lookup; not described as free
Accepted bulk input rows count once each, while same-key replays, reads and failed-item retries add no units
